verses.text: A Prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O YHWH; answer me, for I [am] afflicted and in need.

segments.text: A Prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O YHWH; answer me, for I [am] afflicted and in need.

verses.text: May You guard my life, for [am] I faithful; may You save Your servant—the one trusting in You—You my God.

segments.text: May You guard my life, for [am] I faithful; may You save Your servant—the one trusting in You—You my God.

verses.text: Show favor to me, O Lord, for to You I call out all the day.

segments.text: Show favor to me, O Lord, for to You I call out all the day.

verses.text: Make glad the soul of Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

segments.text: Make glad the soul of Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

verses.text: For You, O Lord, [are] good and forgiving, and abundant in loving devotion to all those calling on You.

segments.text: For You, O Lord, [are] good and forgiving, and abundant in loving devotion to all those calling on You.

verses.text: Give ear, O YHWH, [to] my prayer, and attend to the voice of my pleas.

segments.text: Give ear, O YHWH, [to] my prayer, and attend to the voice of my pleas.

verses.text: In the day of my distress I call on you, for You will answer me!

segments.text: In the day of my distress I call on you, for You will answer me!

verses.text: None like You [is] among the gods, O Lord, and not like Your works.

segments.text: None like You [is] among the gods, O Lord, and not like Your works.

verses.text: All the nations whom You have made shall come and bow down before Your face, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

segments.text: All the nations whom You have made shall come and bow down before Your face, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

verses.text: For You [are] great, and the One doing wonders; You [are] God—You alone.

segments.text: For You [are] great, and the One doing wonders; You [are] God—You alone.

verses.text: Instruct me, O YHWH, [in] Your way, [and] I will walk in Your truth; unite my heart to fear Your name.

segments.text: Instruct me, O YHWH, [in] Your way, [and] I will walk in Your truth; unite my heart to fear Your name.

verses.text: I will confess You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forever.

segments.text: I will confess You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forever.

verses.text: For Your loving devotion [is] great toward me. And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.

segments.text: For Your loving devotion [is] great toward me. And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.

verses.text: O God, arrogant ones have risen against me, and a gathering of ruthless ones have sought my life; and they do not set You before them.

segments.text: O God, arrogant ones have risen against me, and a gathering of ruthless ones have sought my life; and they do not set You before them.

verses.text: But You, O Lord, [are] a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

segments.text: But You, O Lord, [are] a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.

verses.text: Turn to me and show favor to me; give Your strength to Your servant, and give salvation to the son of Your maidservant.

segments.text: Turn to me and show favor to me; give Your strength to Your servant, and give salvation to the son of Your maidservant.

verses.text: Make with me a sign for good, and those hating me will see it and be put to shame! For You, YHWH, have helped me and comforted me!

segments.text: Make with me a sign for good, and those hating me will see it and be put to shame! For You, YHWH, have helped me and comforted me!
